QuestInfo.name: [Moon Festival] The Mini-Game Station Is Back!
QuestInfo.0: #bKemdi#k, the hip hop dawg, has something to say. Go and listen.
QuestInfo.1: #bKemdi#k, the hip hop dawg, says you should check out the #bMini-game Station#k he's starting up. \n\nTalk to #bKemdi#k in town to access the #bMini-game Station#k.
QuestInfo.2: #bKemdi#k, the hip hop dawg, wants you to participate in the various mini-games available at his newly opened #bMini-game Station#k.

0.msg: Yo, mic check pne-two! The name's #bKemdi#k and I've got good news.

1.msg: #b(The dog, er, dawg starts sputtering about 'mini-game flings' and 'guaranteed rewards, wait, no, I meant blings!' By the end, the fur around his mouth is matted in spit.)#k

2.msg: In conclusion, my warm rhymes have convinced you to check out the #b<Return of the Mini-game Station>#k, right? \r\n#b(Find Kemdi, the 'hip hop dawg', in town to check out the Mini-game Station.)#k\r\n

0.msg: #b(Check out the new Mini-game Station, where you can play mini-games.)#k

1.0: You're here for the returnizzle of the #bMini-game Station#k! Mini-games-tizzlefizzle are the joy-izzle of life!

1.2: #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/21/0##fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/22/0##fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/23/0#\r\n(He starts singing a power ballad. His voice cracks on all the high notes.) Cliiiiiiiiick on the bubbles oooooover the NPCs' heads to jooooooin the #bWait List#k for eeeeach mini-game.

yes.0: #b(You've heard everything Kemdi has to say, and even if you hadn't, you can't take any more. Just go check out the games at the Mini-game Station.)#k
